# [BUG] Azure auto-wake never actually worked: wrong workflow, no TLS, no idle auto-stop

## Bug
Visited the deployed frontend (https://filmpire-microservices-tan.vercel.app/) this morning with Azure stopped, expecting the backend to auto-wake per the ADR-018/#160 lifecycle work. It never started. Confirmed live, not suspected.

Root-caused three independent, real bugs (not one):

1. `api/wakeup.js` dispatched `deploy.yml` without the `passphrase` input that workflow requires — GitHub rejects the dispatch (422), swallowed silently by a `catch`. Also targeted the wrong workflow (`deploy.yml` does a full `terraform apply`; `cluster-stop.yml`'s `start` action is the correct non-destructive resume).
2. Azure has no HTTPS anywhere — gateway is plain-HTTP NodePort. The only documented bridge was a manual `cloudflared` tunnel + hand-committed URL, incompatible with "visiting the page is the only trigger."
3. `auto-stop-watchdog.sh` (the 1-hour idle auto-stop) was never scheduled anywhere — dead code.

## Root Cause
See above — three independent gaps, not one. Fixed via ADR-019:
- `infrastructure/kubernetes/overlays/azure/caddy-tls.yaml`: Caddy hostNetwork pod, real Lets Encrypt cert on the node's static public IP.
- `api/wakeup.js`: now dispatches `cluster-stop.yml` start action with a server-side `DEPLOY_PASSPHRASE` mirror.
- `.github/workflows/cluster-idle-stop.yml`: scheduled (every 10 min) idle check + non-destructive stop.
- NSG rules for 80/443 added in `infrastructure/terraform/modules/network`.

Knowingly narrows ADR-015's "no public cloud-spend trigger" rule — confirmed with project owner first, see ADR-019 "Relationship to ADR-015".

## Severity vs. Priority
**Severity (technical impact):** Critical — the core "visit the site, it just works" promise of #160 was non-functional.
**Priority (business urgency):** P1

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Visiting the deployed frontend with Azure stopped wakes it within the ~90s estimate, no manual step
- [x] Backend reachable over real HTTPS at filmpire-api.duckdns.org with a valid cert
- [x] Backend auto-stops within ~70 min of the last real request, data preserved on PVCs
- [x] Regression test / live verification recorded in this issue

## Notes
Verified: `cluster-idle-stop.yml` runs every 10 minutes; `caddy-tls.yaml` in the aws and azure overlays.
